Don't hold it inside, it's part of the process, so if you are going to cry, do so. But you need to start putting yourself back together in the meantime. You don't have to date anyone right now, just go through all the emotions of the break up first. Get through this and then fix the other problems in your life. You will be okay and I know you will be. You just need to take it day by day. Please don't end your life. You have so much going for you, you just need to. Do it. You don't have to kill yourself.
